options.content:
## Quality & latency comparison (Postgres)
Aggregates from `evaluation_metrics`. Compare **baseline / RAG / fine-tuned** and **CPU vs GPU**. Primary latency metric is **time_to_response** (= retrieval + generation). Speedup = CPU seconds ÷ GPU seconds.

targets.rawSql: SELECT approach || ' | ' || COALESCE(device, 'unknown') AS series, AVG(quality_score) AS quality FROM evaluation_metrics WHERE quality_score IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT approach || ' | ' || COALESCE(device, 'unknown') AS series, AVG(COALESCE(time_to_response, generation_time + COALESCE(retrieval_time, 0))) AS time_to_response_sec FROM evaluation_metrics WHERE generation_time IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH lat AS (
  SELECT approach,
         COALESCE(device, 'unknown') AS device,
         AVG(COALESCE(time_to_response, generation_time + COALESCE(retrieval_time, 0))) AS ttr
  FROM evaluation_metrics
  WHERE generation_time IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT c.approach AS series,
       (c.ttr / NULLIF(g.ttr, 0)) AS gpu_speedup_x
FROM lat c
JOIN lat g ON c.approach = g.approach
WHERE c.device = 'cpu' AND g.device IN ('cuda', 'gpu')
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: GPU speedup (CPU time_to_response ÷ GPU) — >1× means GPU faster

targets.rawSql:
SELECT approach,
       AVG(COALESCE(retrieval_time, 0)) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(device,'') IN ('cpu')) AS retrieval_cpu,
       AVG(generation_time) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(device,'') IN ('cpu')) AS generation_cpu,
       AVG(COALESCE(retrieval_time, 0)) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(device,'') IN ('cuda','gpu')) AS retrieval_cuda,
       AVG(generation_time) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(device,'') IN ('cuda','gpu')) AS generation_cuda
FROM evaluation_metrics
WHERE generation_time IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY approach
ORDER BY approach

panels.title: Latency breakdown: retrieval vs generation (CPU / CUDA)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT approach,
       COALESCE(device, 'unknown') AS device,
       COUNT(*) AS n_answers,
       ROUND(AVG(quality_score)::numeric, 3) AS avg_quality,
       ROUND(AVG("rougeL")::numeric, 3) AS avg_rouge_l,
       ROUND(AVG(bert_score)::numeric, 3) AS avg_bert,
       ROUND(AVG(faithfulness)::numeric, 3) AS avg_faithfulness,
       ROUND(AVG(retrieval_hit_at_k)::numeric, 3) AS avg_hit_at_k,
       ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(time_to_response, generation_time + COALESCE(retrieval_time, 0)))::numeric, 2) AS avg_ttr_sec,
       ROUND(AVG(generation_time)::numeric, 2) AS avg_gen_sec,
       ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(retrieval_time, 0))::numeric, 3) AS avg_retrieval_sec
FROM evaluation_metrics
GROUP BY approach, COALESCE(device, 'unknown')
ORDER BY approach, device
